facts.text: Jolene and her partner attended a yoga retreat where they experienced a sunrise that lit up the sky with bright colors.

evidence.quote: We had an awesome yoga retreat. The place was so peaceful and the view during yoga was amazing - the sunrise lit up the whole sky with bright colors.

facts.text: Jolene and her partner felt connected to nature and themselves during the yoga retreat.

evidence.quote: Doing yoga with that backdrop made me feel connected to nature and myself.

facts.text: Jolene and her partner had an awesome time at the yoga retreat, which made them feel peaceful and thankful.

evidence.quote: I felt incredibly peaceful and thankful.
